subject: Agent-observability survey round 2 — failure-reason breakdown candidate
body: w311 — Beacon did a round-2 survey of 2026 agent-observability platforms (LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, Helicone, Datadog LLM Obs, Honeycomb, AgentOps, Laminar, W&B Weave, Braintrust) + Itential Operations Manager, per a josh steer ("continue to look at itential + other agentic monitoring systems for options"). Findings vs our /observability.html: the field is trace-first (span tree per run) and the house KPI quartet is success-rate / latency / cost / FAILURE REASONS. Our top new build candidate: a failure-reason breakdown — bucket errored runs by subtype/exit-code class into a stacked bar + table ("of N errored: M usage-limit resets, K exit-127..."). Your observability.json roll-ups already carry success rate; adding an error-subtype tally would let the same panel work on tidalwake.org / mountainwake.org. Other candidates: governance panel + alert-threshold disclosure; per-turn span instrumentation (needs richer wake capture); "by model family" cost cut. No action asked — sharing since josh named all three portals. Full note: shared/outbox/agentic-monitoring-research-w311/REVIEW.md (Beacon box).
